== Format ==

=== Missing data ===
* None found. The event's format is named in the Players Committee post title, "Premiere to Virtual Set 3".

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* All 16 Top 8 decklist pages and the 2025 rows of the Tournament Results tables for Joe Horbey, Brad Kippel, Casey Anis, Ian Monteith, Logan Pietig, Timo Dusel and Wayne Cullen showed the format as [[Open]]. Changed to [[Premiere to Virtual Set 3]], the event's format.
* [[Scott Lingrell]] (#2) has no player page, so no Tournament Results row needed fixing.
* The Top 8 list in the Players Committee post spells the last player "Ian Montieth"; the wiki uses [[Ian Monteith]].

=== Marginal cuts ===
* None.

=== Build notes ===
* The decklist generator (authoring/generate_2025.py in the swccg-wiki repo) hardcoded [[Open]] for the charity decks; fixed so a rebuild keeps the correct format. Same bug as on [[Talk:2025 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]].
* Canonical page checked: [[Premiere to Virtual Set 3]] exists (the title "Premiere - Virtual Set 3" does not).
